title: ephemeral-agents task message (v1)
description: The inter-zone contract: the message the manager publishes to the agent.tasks topic, consumed by the lifecycle's message adapter. Contract owner: the V2 schema policy (platform design §5 - additive-only evolution).

task_id.description: Unique task identifier and THE idempotency key: the Temporal workflow ID is task_id (WP-1.3). Duplicate task_id = no second workflow.

agent_ref.description: repo location + repo folder containing the agent's markdown (persona, skill, tools) - diagram Note 1.

behavioral_spec.description: The Behavioral Specification passed by the manager (diagram Note 1).

repo_target.description: Project Repo the coder writes code to.

requester.description: Who asked - carries the response path. The two-way Manager-RabbitMQ response is correlated on task_id (no separate correlation_id: task_id is the single identifier for request and response).

ttl_s.description: OPTIONAL - the manager is the ONLY writer; sized max(3 x B1 boot-time p50, brief estimate). When absent, the lifecycle applies EA_TTL_DEFAULT (900s). The reaper is authoritative either way (R1 backstop).

priority.description: OPTIONAL (M1, OQ1/OQ4) - coarse priority enum; the broker queue is declared with x-max-priority and the manager validates + passes the field through (the CoS never talks to the broker directly, D8). Absent = normal broker semantics. Additive-only evolution; field and consumer land in the same gated change.

approval_hash.description: OPTIONAL (M1, TP-V2-M1 assertion 10) - SHA-256 hex over the UTF-8 behavioral_spec, whitespace-exact (byte-for-byte, no normalization). Tamper-EVIDENCE for post-hoc audit, not tamper-prevention: the manager enforces retry integrity (identical spec hash across a task_id's retries) and mismatch-reject-and-surface; the gateway-side approval-registration upgrade is a later, separately-gated change.
